subject: Transitioning Tuesday's intro demo to hands-on scoping workshop
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Mehta <caroline@neurolytics.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Transitioning Tuesday's intro demo to hands-on scoping workshop

Hi Caroline —

Quick update on our side. I’m realizing that given the goals you shared (tight timeline for a Q1 POC + a few integration questions), the standard 30‑m intro demo won't give us enough time to get to a concrete POC plan.

Would you be open to converting Tuesday's scheduled intro (09/15 at 11:00am PT) into a 75‑minute hands‑on scoping workshop instead? In that format we can: 
- Walk through a short demo of the model in your use case (~20m)
- Validate data connectivity and security constraints (~20m)
- Draft a mutual action plan and success criteria together (~25m)

If that works for you I’ll update the calendar invite and loop in our solutions engineer. If not, we can keep the intro and schedule a follow-up deep dive.

Attachments: POC-Agenda-v1.pdf (agenda stub)

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Caroline Mehta <caroline@neurolytics.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@neurolytics.ai
Date: 2026-09-14T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Transitioning Tuesday's intro demo to hands-on scoping workshop

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the suggestion. That actually sounds ideal: the team wants to leave Tuesday with a clear list of next steps and a preliminary MLP (minimum viable pipeline) outline. 75 minutes is fine for us. Can you confirm who from Redwood will attend? We'll have: me, our engineering lead (Jai), and someone from procurement on the call.

A couple of asks before the workshop:
- Can you send over a short mutual action plan template so procurement can preview it?
- Are there any pre-reqs for the connectivity portion (VPN, sample data)?

If you can share the agenda and M-A-P I'll get procurement to review today.

—Caroline
Head of Product, Neurolytics
caroline@neurolytics.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Mehta <caroline@neurolytics.ai>, procurement@neurolytics.ai
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Transitioning Tuesday's intro demo to hands-on scoping workshop

Perfect — thanks, Caroline.

Attendees from Redwood: me, Stephanie Nguyen (Solutions Engineer), and LAURA BENNETT (Sales Manager) will pop in for the first 10 minutes to align on success criteria.

Answers to your asks: 
- Mutual action plan template: attaching an editable XLSX (Neurolytics-Mutual-Action-Plan.xlsx). Please review and mark any procurement questions; we can capture redlines during the workshop.
- Connectivity pre-reqs: no VPN required for the demo itself; for a true integration test we'll request a small S3 bucket or a sample CSV and a short-lived API key. If you prefer, Stephanie can run a quick checklist beforehand — would you like her to pull that into the invite?

I updated the invite to be 75 minutes and renamed it to "Hands-on scoping workshop: Redwood x Neurolytics". See calendar link below.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcdef123
Attachments: Neurolytics-Mutual-Action-Plan.xlsx, POC-Agenda-v1.pdf

Thanks — we'll aim to have a draft MAP and a proposed timeline by EOD Wednesday.

Rishi

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T12:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Transitioning Tuesday's intro demo to hands-on scoping workshop

Thanks for looping me in. A couple of quick notes from a manager perspective:
- Approve the workshop conversion — this aligns with our playbook for accelerated POCs.
- If procurement raises standard enterprise terms requests, escalate to me and I'll coordinate with Contracts.
- Offer a single day of engineering office hours as a goodwill credit if they commit to a pilot in the next 30 days.

Stephanie — please create a brief pre-call checklist (5 items max) and drop it in the invite so the Neurolytics engineers can prepare. Rishi, confirm if we should include the office hours credit in writing.

Laura
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Mehta <caroline@neurolytics.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Transitioning Tuesday's intro demo to hands-on scoping workshop

Hi Caroline — looping in a short prep checklist below and attaching a PDF agenda. Happy to run a 10‑minute tech check 30 minutes before the workshop if that helps.

Prep checklist (5 items):
1) Share a small sample dataset (CSV or S3 link) or a representative schema by EOD today.
2) Confirm an engineering attendee (name and email).
3) Confirm any IP/KMS restrictions we should be aware of.
4) Add procurement questions to the MAP spreadsheet.
5) Accept the rescheduled invite (75 minutes) — link in calendar.

Attachments: POC-Agenda-v1.pdf

I can run the connectivity portion and validate a sample ingestion flow in the workshop. Let me know if you'd like the 10‑minute tech check.

—Stephanie
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
